That response feels right. When I typed the phrase with a missing closing quote, it didn't panic and wipe the screen or tell me there were zero matches — my whole collection stayed right there, with a calm little note asking me to add the closing quotation mark to finish the phrase. So mid-typing, when my search isn't finished yet, it just waits for me to complete it instead of making it look like everything vanished. That's exactly what I'd want; a half-typed search shouldn't feel like something broke.

I'm happy with that. What's next?
